articles.author: Edible Garden AG Inc
articles.headline: Edible Garden Secures Multi-Year Private Label Supply Agreement, Expanding Partnership with Major Midwest Big-Box Retailer
articles.summary: Edible Garden announced expansion of a private-label herb supply agreement with an unnamed Midwest retailer through December 2028. The agreement does not quantify guaranteed realized future revenue.
